rv.q: The play wants to present SNL's start as game-changing, but there’s little in the way of a backdrop or context against which to contrast its supposedly revolutionary nature.
The script’s refusal to pick a lane muddies the waters, but it is an entertaining piece of work.
‘Not Ready for Prime Time’ can’t decide what story it wants to tell, and winds up setting up too many plot threads over too many short scenes that never lead anywhere in particular
